generated_test_cases.title: Handle missing database URL
generated_test_cases.description: Test get_db behavior when DATABASE_URL environment variable is not set.
expected_results: Raises a ValueError with message indicating missing DATABASE_URL

generated_test_cases.description: Verify that the main application initializes without errors and loads configuration.
expected_results: Application starts and logs initialization success

generated_test_cases.title: Create item missing name field
generated_test_cases.description: Attempt to create an item without the required 'name' field and expect validation failure.
steps: Send POST request to /items/ with JSON body {"description": "Missing name"}.
expected_results: Response status code is 422 (Unprocessable Entity) with validation error indicating missing 'name'.

generated_test_cases.title: Delete non‑existent item
generated_test_cases.description: Verify that deleting an item that does not exist returns a 404 error.
steps: Send DELETE request to /items/9999 where 9999 is an ID not present in the database.
expected_results: Response status code is 404 as defined in exception_status_mappings.

generated_test_cases.title: Delete existing item successfully
generated_test_cases.description: Ensure that deleting an existing item returns a 204 status and removes the record.
steps: Create an item via POST /items/ with valid data.
Query the database for the item.
expected_results: The item is no longer present in the database.

generated_test_cases.title: Create item with maximum field lengths
generated_test_cases.description: Test boundary conditions by providing maximum allowed lengths for name and description.
steps: Construct a JSON payload where 'name' and 'description' are at their maximum length limits.
Send POST request to /items/ with this payload.
expected_results: Response status code is 201 and the item is created successfully without truncation.

generated_test_cases.title: Delete non-db item positive
generated_test_cases.description: Verify that deleting an item that does not exist returns 204 and no error.

generated_test_cases.title: Delete item with not-db-item positive
generated_test_cases.description: Verify deletion when item exists (not(not db_item))

generated_test_cases.title: Get item function positive
generated_test_cases.description: Ensure get_item function returns correct item data

generated_test_cases.title: Delete item when database flag is false (not (not db_item))
generated_test_cases.description: Verify that when the system indicates an item exists but the deletion condition fails, the API still returns 404.
steps: Mock database to return a valid item for ID 1234 but set internal flag such that delete condition is negated.
expected_results: API responds with 404 Not Found status code.
Response body contains error message indicating deletion condition not met.

generated_test_cases.title: Unauthorized access to create_item endpoint
generated_test_cases.description: Attempt to call the POST /items/ endpoint without proper authentication to verify that security checks are enforced.
steps: Send a POST request to /items/ with a valid ItemCreate payload but without authentication headers.
expected_results: The response status code should be 401 Unauthorized (or appropriate security error).

generated_test_cases.title: Update item with name provided
generated_test_cases.description: Verify update_item correctly updates the name field when a non-null name is supplied.
steps: Create an item with initial name 'OldName' and description 'Desc'.
expected_results: The item’s name is 'NewName' while description remains 'Desc'.

generated_test_cases.title: Update item without name (name is None)
generated_test_cases.description: Verify update_item does not alter the name when the provided name is null.
steps: Create an item with name 'OriginalName' and description 'Desc'.

generated_test_cases.title: Update item with description provided
generated_test_cases.description: Verify update_item correctly updates the description field when a non-null description is supplied.
steps: Create an item with name 'Name' and description 'OldDesc'.
expected_results: The item’s description is 'NewDesc' while name remains 'Name'.

generated_test_cases.title: Create item with maximum length name
generated_test_cases.description: Validate that creating an item with a name at the maximum allowed length succeeds.
steps: Generate a name string exactly at the maximum length constraint (e.g., 255 characters).
Send a POST request to /items/ with the generated name and a valid description.
expected_results: Item is stored with the provided maximum-length name.

generated_test_cases.title: Update item with empty name
generated_test_cases.description: Check that providing an empty string for name updates the name to empty.
steps: Create an item with a non‑empty name.
expected_results: Update returns 200 and name is now ''.

generated_test_cases.title: Update item with both name and description null
generated_test_cases.description: Validate that when both optional fields are null, the repository leaves both attributes unchanged.
steps: Create an item with name 'A' and description 'B'.
PUT /items/{item_id} with an empty JSON object {}.
expected_results: Update returns 200 and makes no changes.

generated_test_cases.title: Update item with name set to None explicitly
generated_test_cases.description: Test that sending name: null does not overwrite existing name (covers not (item.name is not None)).
expected_results: Update succeeds with 200 and does not change the name.

generated_test_cases.title: Update item with description set to None explicitly
generated_test_cases.description: Ensure that sending description: null preserves the existing description (covers not (item.description is not None)).

generated_test_cases.title: Update item with both name and description None
generated_test_cases.description: Cover the branches where both name and description are not None checks evaluate to false.
steps: Create an item with name 'N' and description 'D'.
